BiblicalUsage: Snow is whiteness, cold, and the storehouse of God. Benaiah slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day, God asks Job whether he has entered into the treasures of the snow, and Isaiah says as the snow comes down from heaven and waters the earth, so shall God's word be. The virtuous woman is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all are clothed with scarlet.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe snow preaches both power and provision. It falls from heaven and does not return empty, and I hold that God's word works the same way.
